title: Motor imagery dataset from Ma et al. 2020
description: This dataset contains 62-channel EEG recordings from 25 healthy right-handed subjects performing kinesthetic motor imagery of the right hand or right elbow (same limb, different joints). Each subject completed 15 sessions across 3 days, yielding 600 trials total, designed to study joint-specific motor imagery for brain-computer interface (BCI) applications such as motor rehabilitation and prosthetic control. The data were converted to BIDS format using MOABB from the original dataset published by Ma et al. (2020) in Scientific Data.
methods_description: EEG was recorded using a Neuroscan SynAmps2 system with 62 channels (standard_1005 montage) plus auxiliary EOG and mastoid channels, sampled at 1000 Hz with 50 Hz line noise. Subjects performed kinesthetic motor imagery of the right hand or right elbow following a visual cue, with 4-second imagery trials, in an offline synchronous paradigm across 15 sessions per subject (3 days x 5 sessions/day, 40 trials/session).
